The area of a square is 144 cm². What is its perimeter?
questions.solution: Side = √144 = 12 cm. Perimeter = 4×12 = 48 cm

questions.text: If a/b = 3/4 and b = 20, what is a?
A person buys 10 oranges for ₹30 and sells them at 6 for ₹24. What is the profit/loss percentage?
questions.solution: CP per orange = ₹3. SP per orange = ₹4. Profit = ₹1 per orange. Profit% = 1/3 × 100 = 33.33%

questions.text: Find the compound interest on ₹5000 at 10% per annum for 2 years.
A boat travels 20 km upstream in 5 hours and 24 km downstream in 3 hours. Find the speed of the stream.
questions.solution: Upstream speed = 20/5 = 4 km/h. Downstream speed = 24/3 = 8 km/h. Stream speed = (8-4)/2 = 2 km/h

questions.text: In how many years will ₹2000 become ₹2420 at 10% per annum compounded annually?
A bag contains 3 red, 4 blue, and 5 green balls. One ball is picked at random. What is the probability it is blue?
questions.solution: Total = 12 balls. Blue = 4. P = 4/12 = 1/3

questions.text: A and B invest ₹5000 and ₹8000 in a business. If the total profit is ₹2600 after one year, what is A's share?
How many 3-digit numbers are divisible by 7?
questions.solution: First 3-digit multiple of 7 = 105 (15×7). Last = 994 (142×7). Count = 142-15+1 = 128

questions.text: The diameter of a cylinder is 14 cm and height is 20 cm. Find its volume.
questions.solution: Radius = 7 cm. Volume = πr²h = 22/7 × 49 × 20 = 22 × 7 × 20 = 3080 cm³

questions.text: In how many ways can the letters of the word "LEADER" be arranged?
questions.solution: 6 letters with E repeated twice. Arrangements = 6!/2! = 720/2 = 360

questions.text: A milkman mixes water with milk in ratio 1:4. If he sells the mixture at ₹40/L making 25% profit, find the cost price of pure milk.
questions.solution: SP = 40 at 25% profit → CP = 40/1.25 = 32 per L of mixture. In 5L mixture: 1L water + 4L milk. Cost of 4L milk = 5×32 = 160. CP of milk = 160/4 = 40/L

questions.text: What is 15% of 200? (Variant 25)
In a row of 40 students, Ravi is 15th from the left. What is his rank from the right?
questions.solution: Rank from right = (Total - Rank from left + 1) = 40 - 15 + 1 = 26th

questions.text: Find the missing term: 2, 6, 12, 20, __, 42
questions.solution: Differences: 4,6,8,10,12. Next = 20+10 = 30

questions.text: If CLOCK is coded as 3-12-15-3-11, how is TIME coded?
questions.solution: Each letter is replaced by its alphabet position: T=20, I=9, M=13, E=5

questions.text: P is the brother of Q. R is the sister of P. S is the father of R. How is Q related to S?
questions.solution: S is father of R and P, so Q is child of S. Q's gender not specified, so son or daughter

questions.text: If South-East becomes North, then East becomes what?
questions.solution: Each direction rotates 135° clockwise. East → South-West

questions.text: Statement: All pens are pencils. No pencil is an eraser. Conclusion: I. No pen is an eraser. II. Some pencils are pens.
questions.solution: All pens are pencils which are not erasers, so I is true. All pens are pencils implies some pencils are pens, so II is true

questions.text: How many pairs of letters are there in "MATHEMATICS" which have as many letters between them as in the alphabet?
questions.solution: Pairs: M-A (skip N), T-I (skip U) - need to check. Actually M(13)-A(1)=12. Skip length analysis needed.

questions.text: A is taller than B but shorter than C. D is taller than A. Who is the shortest?
questions.solution: C > A > B and D > A, so B is the shortest

questions.text: Choose the odd one: Apple, Mango, Orange, Potato
questions.solution: Potato is a vegetable; others are fruits

questions.text: If "ADVENTURE" is written as "VEDANTRU", how is "BUSINESS" written?
questions.solution: Pattern: reverse first 3, then reverse next 3? A D V → V D A? Actually ADVENTURE has 9 letters. Split in 3-3-3: ADV→VDA, ENT→TNE, URE→ERU. VDATNEERU. Not matching. Let me think differently.

questions.text: If the day after tomorrow is Sunday, what day was it yesterday?
questions.solution: Day after tomorrow = Sunday → tomorrow = Saturday → today = Friday → yesterday = Thursday

questions.text: Find the next term: AZ, BY, CX, DW, ?
questions.solution: First letter: A→B→C→D→E. Second letter: Z→Y→X→W→V. So EV

questions.text: In a certain code, "apple" is written as "elppa". How is "mango" written?
questions.solution: The word is simply reversed: mango → ognam

questions.text: Six friends A, B, C, D, E, F sit in a circle facing center. A is between F and B. D is opposite A. C is between E and D. Who is opposite B?
questions.solution: A between F&B. D opposite A. C between E&D. Arrangement: A at 12, B at 10, F at 2, D at 6, E at 4, C at 8. Opposite B(10) is E(4)

questions.text: Statement: Some cats are dogs. All dogs are animals. Conclusion: I. Some animals are cats. II. No cat is an animal.
questions.solution: Some cats are dogs → all dogs are animals → some cats are animals. I follows. II contradicts.

questions.text: Pointing to a lady, a man said "She is the mother of my daughter's only brother." How is the lady related to the man?
questions.solution: My daughter's only brother = my son. Mother of my son = my wife

questions.text: A man walks 5 km east, turns right and walks 3 km, then turns right and walks 5 km. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.solution: East 5, then South 3, then West 5. Net displacement = 3 km South from start

questions.text: How many meaningful English words can be formed with letters R, O, P, T using each letter once?
questions.solution: PORT and TROP (short for tropical). Also SPORT needs S. Actually PORT and TROP = 2 words

questions.text: If in a certain language, FLOWER is written as UOLVRI, how is GARDEN written?
questions.solution: Each letter replaced by its reverse alphabet position: F→U, L→O, O→L, W→D, E→V, R→I. G→T, A→Z, R→I, D→W, E→V, N→M. So TZIIVM

questions.text: A is 5 years older than B. B is 3 years younger than C. A is 20. How old is C?
In a class, 60% are boys and rest girls. If 40% of boys and 30% of girls passed, what percentage of students passed?
questions.solution: Assume 100 students: 60 boys (40% = 24 passed), 40 girls (30% = 12 passed). Total passed = 36, so 36%

questions.text: Find the wrong term: 3, 7, 15, 31, 63, 125
If A + B means A is the brother of B, A - B means A is the sister of B, A × B means A is the father of B, then P - Q + R means?
questions.solution: P - Q = P is sister of Q. Q + R = Q is brother of R. So P is sister of Q who is brother of R. Thus P is sister of R

questions.text: In a row of 40 students, Ravi is 15th from the left. What is his rank from the right? (Variant 25)
questions.solution: Rank from right = (Total - Rank from left + 1) = 40 - 15 + 1 = 26th

questions.solution: "Since" is used with a specific point in time (2015)

questions.solution: Defeat is the opposite of victory

questions.solution: A philatelist collects stamps; a numismatist collects coins

questions.text: Which article is used before "university"?
questions.solution: "University" begins with a consonant sound /juː/, so "a" is used

questions.solution: Teach → taught (irregular verb)

questions.text: Find the error: Neither the teacher nor the students was present.
questions.solution: When subjects are joined by "neither...nor", the verb agrees with the nearer subject. Here "students" is plural, so "were" is correct instead of "was"

questions.text: _________ you finish your homework, you cannot go out to play.
